<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/users/agents"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



This call makes an agent account. An agent acts as its own identity in the workspace, so Vantik records its changes against the agent. Any member can make a personal agent. Only an admin can make a workspace agent. The response of a personal agent holds its token. Vantik shows the token this one time only. A workspace agent gets no token.
